about_the_game:
“Echoes of the Wind” is a psychological thriller where camping in the woods turns unsettling. Unravel mysteries, face hidden fears, and survive what lurks beyond the trees in chilling silence.

This is a first-person camping simulation set in the vast Canadian wilderness. Players experience the tranquility and challenges of backcountry camping— Setting up tent and campfire, fishing, cooking meals, and a nice cold beer on hand. The game blends camping simulation with atmospheric storytelling, immersing players in the beauty of Canada’s wilderness.

But as night falls, unease creeps in. Distant branches snap. Shadows shift between the trees. Something is out there—lurking, watching. The line between nature’s ordinary dangers and something far darker begins to blur.

Players will experience the authentic camping experience while also confronting an unseen presence in the woods.

Key Features:

  • Authentic Canadian camping simulation.

  • Fishing Mechanic

  • Wilflife Encounters

  • Narrative branches balancing peaceful exploration and psychological horror.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror themes and depictions of blood. There are no sexual themes, sexual assault, or non-consensual acts. The violence is limited to environmental blood imagery used for atmosphere, not extreme gore

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 and later
  • Processor: Dual-core (e.g., i3-6100, or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB | AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
  • Additional Notes: Use headphone to have a full experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core (i3-8100 / Ryzen 2200G or better)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660Ti 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
  • Additional Notes: Use headphone to have a full experience

short_description: After a fight with her fiancé, Naomi Lee goes camping on her usual trail to clear her mind. But the woods hold more than memories—something sinister is waiting in the dark.
